instruction: Cinematic medium shot of three young girls standing close together in a sunny park. On the left, the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan (R3) smiles brightly at the camera, holding the center girl's arm. In the center, the girl with a pink headband (R6) laughs happily, looking forward. On the right, the girl with bangs in a blue cardigan (R4) grins warmly, leaning in close to the group. The warm golden hour sunlight backlights the girls, creating a soft, glowing atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
